Game Overview

Collect the Gift is a puzzle title where guide gifts to Santa's bag by solving festive puzzles in a magical workshop. Cut ropes, launch slingshots, and trigger switches to ensure every package reaches its destination. Enjoy the thrill and challenge reminiscent of beloved classics, all in a delightful holiday setting. Perfect for some seasonal fun!
